notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT! v1.4.11: THE RAD ACHIEVEMENT UPDATE IS LIVE ON STEAM
notes.content:
Hey Grifters...

[b]PATCH NOTES 1.4.11[/b]
[list]
[*] Added NEW ACHIEVEMENTS
[*] General fixes to animation issues.
[*] Fixing an issue on Switch where compression was turned off in Las Venganza
[*] Fixing an issue where players can get zoomed in by accident at the beginning of Las Venganza
[*] Changing save points in Las Venganza to not save during cutscene
[*] Fixed a thing where paper garbage was referred to as plastic garbage, which is the kind of mis-classification that results in ecological waste, folks
[/list]
Launched on Steam 08.10, coming to Xbox VERY SOON (pending a short test and cert pass) AND our team is currently in the process of testing this patch for the Nintendo Switch.

[b]ANNOUNCEMENT! v1.4.11: THE RAD ACHIEVEMENT UPDATE IS LIVE ON STEAM[/b]

What’s up folks, been a minute since we added fresh patch notes, but here we are!

We’ve got some new, fresh achievements coming in. Requested by our dope Xbox community to get us to round out the GamerScore, you know we gotta bring em to Steam too. There’s a fun one in Lisbon for you, and some high score challenges in Rad Skater too, for the extreme score hunters, or the folks that know how to magically cheat at the game. ;)

In addition to that, we fixed some issues around the save point at the beginning of LV1, as players can get stuck in a weird hellish limbo state if the save happens before that cutscene is done. Well, NO LONGER. 

More fun fixes in the future, and thanks for your love and support!


Con and on, 
Dave

notes.title: Mighty News for The Big Con: Patch v1.2.0
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! 👋


We have some Mighty big news to yell about in our latest [b]Patch v1.2.0[/b], specifically for anyone who was loading game save data from before the last Patch v1.1.24.

Players loading older game saves should no longer experience crashes when opening the notebook, inventory or menu! (Insert Mighty Yelling here!)

This nasty bug took a lot of work to identify, but with help from our team plus testing from some of our community members, and some verification with [i]UNITY THEMSELVES[/i], we’re feeling pretty good that it’s squashed.

Thanks for all your support and understanding while we took the time to get this patch ready; our community has been totally rad about it, and we’re really glad to get this out to you all!

There’s a lot of exciting stuff we’re working on behind the scenes right now, and our team is very excited to share more news - SOON ([i]trombone interlude[/i]…) 

But for now, please enjoy The (*improved*) Big Con experience and as always, hit us up on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1139280/discussions/]Community Hub[/url] if you encounter any issues or unanswered questions!

With much appreciation,

- The Mighty Yell Team 🤟

notes.title: PATCH v1.1.24 aka THE CHUCKLES & CHECKPOINTS UPDATE IS LIVE
notes.content:
Hey Grifters… 

[b]PATCH NOTES v1.1.24[/b] aka THE CHUCKLES & CHECKPOINTS UPDATE
[list]
[*] Fixing an issue in Control Remapping where the player could assign two conflicting maps to the same button
[*] Minor content stability fixes and typo fixes
[*] Performance spike fixes across game through optimization
[*] Implemented fixed autosave points at each major storybeat
[*] Implemented approximately 80x more laughtrack lines.
[/list]
You’ll Laugh… You’ll Cry… You’ll… save your game more frequently! 😎

This patch is one we had to bump to a bit after launch, but we’ve locked in and stabilized our autosave points throughout the game. Major storybeats and quest completion now have your back, saving and making sure that you don’t have to worry about it (just watch the floppy disk!)

Also, we’ve added a ton more laughs, boos, and cheers to the game with our laughtrack feature. We always wanted to get more giggles into the game, and this was a great way to end off our year of patches. 

Does this mean I can say the game is now 80x funnier? 🤔

Yes. Yes it does. 😎

Happy laughing, 
- Dave at Mighty Yell

Performance spike fixes across game through optimization

notes.title: PATCH v1.1.17 IS LIVE!
notes.content:
[b]PATCH NOTES 1.1.17 - SO MANY UPDATES! [/b]

[list]
[*] Control remapping has been added. Now players can remap buttons to any other buttons of their choice.
[*] Windowed mode has been added for PC Players.
[*] We have fixed a variety of bugs associated with control remapping and controller glyphs.
[*] We have addressed numerous level stability issues.
[*] We have made Sammy slightly easier to find in LV2. 
[*] And of course, we added a great deal of love ❤️ 
[/list]

Hey Grifters, this is a big one we’ve been working on for a while! 
You [i]might[/i] even say this patch is the motherlode… (hi Mom!) 

We are VERY excited to introduce this huge patch for you, our dedicated and amazing players. It features two huge items we’ve wanted to include since launch: [b]Windowed Mode[/b] and [b]CONTROL REMAPPING[/b].

That’s right, you can now remap all your actions as you see fit, so if you have alternate control schemes you’d prefer or want to try out, we’ve got you covered! (And if we missed something, you know we want to hear from you.)

Also, for our players using wider screens, or players that like to play with on-screen keyboards, we’ve introduced windowed mode; now you don’t have to play The Big Con in full screen mode!

In addition to these two items, we’ve introduced a TON of fixes. We’ve made some important characters easier to find, and others less likely to do weird stuff; so all in all, we are feeling good about this patch.

We’ve still got much more planned for you, so stay tuned for more updates, join our Discord or our Steam Community, and please share what you think!


Thanks for all your support & stay Rad, 

Dave 😎

notes.title: Patch 1.0.45 is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey Con Artists (and aspiring Trombone players),

Patch 1.0.45 is now live with updates to address the following:

[list]
[*] Addressing multiple Addressable-related crashes mid-conversation affecting PC players
[*] Addressing an issue where inventory icons were mis-matched in the inventory
[*] Fixing an issue where the notebook does not show the player’s financial goal in Las Venganza
[*] Fixing an issue where the Suspicion widget did not perform as expected
[*] Fixing a softlock found on the ARG / Sneakerhead quest in conversation branches
[*] Fixing a softlock found in failure in Las Venganza in a VERY specific scenario where you fail Dan the Man (but don’t call him that, EVER)
[*] Fixing an issue where the mall doors open way too early and you can leave and miss the level
[*] Decreasing the pickpocket value of multiple multi-level characters

[/list]

To our players on Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S, we are aware of some reported crashes on version 1.0.25 and are submitting a patch that hopefully addresses them.

As always, you can talk to us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1139280/discussions/1/?snr=2_9_100000_]Steam Community[/url] forums or in [url=https://discord.com/invite/xypFJdaBXk]our Discord[/url], and thanks a lot for your reports (and your patience!)

- Mighty Yell :)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.25 is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Grifters, patch 1.0.25 is now live on Steam![/h1]

We wanted to hustle (GET IT??) this one out to you to solve a couple issues in one quick push. We couldn’t have found these issues without the love and help of our awesome community, so if you’re reading this, chances are it's because of you and people like you that it got done so quickly. 

V1.0.25 fixes two misfiring achievements, so achievement hunters that are up for a replay should have anything they missed get checked off. 

More importantly though, the patch adds a quick fix to recenter the camera on Ali whenever the game is paused. This is a fast and easy fix to make sure that say, if you failed on the Midlands Hormliner and the camera got stuck? As long as you can pause the game, the camera will find you again. 

As always, you can talk to us on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1139280/discussions/1/]Steam Community forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/xypFJdaBXk]in our Discord[/url], and let us know if you notice anything weird or, I dunno, just how much you like the game.

Stay Rad,

Dave 😎

notes.title: If you have the demo, read THIS!
notes.content:
We've noticed that some players who played our demo are finding a buggy pause menu.
If your pause menu is giving you issues, there are two steps to fix this.

1. If you still have the demo, please uninstall it from your steam library;
2. Reset your save data from the options menu.

Apologies if you experienced this issue, but the two steps above should resolve!

- Mighty Yell :)
